# FameUp 🚀

FameUp is a full-stack social media web application inspired by Instagram.

## Features ✨

- User Login & Register
- Create Posts
- Upload Images
- Like Posts
- Comment System
- User Profiles
- Followers & Following
- Profile Photos
- Responsive UI

## Technologies Used 💻

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Node.js
- Express.js
- MongoDB
- Mongoose
